installCommand: npm install && cd source && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: npm test && cd source && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && pnpm exec parcel build index.html --dist-dir dist --no-source-maps && mkdir -p ../_site && pnpm exec html-inline dist/index.html > ../_site/index.html && cp ../config.js ../_site/config.js
